scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @zuryo/backend" "npm run dev -w @zuryo/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @zuryo/backend && npm run build -w @zuryo/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zuryo/backend && npm run typecheck -w @zuryo/frontend
